analogy.rationale: Gamma secretase inhibitors block PSEN1/Notch cleavage, but Notch pathway components are variably expressed and the transcriptional signature is typically modest; the closest reference classes are other Notch/hedgehog pathway modulators and general antineoplastic agents, though none share a strong downstream program.
